title: Mark Cuban on the NBA, Cost Plus Drugs, and How to Fix Politics

thesis: Mark Cuban argues that successful modern politics and media distribution depend on understanding algorithms and salesmanship rather than relying on traditional platforms. He predicts that the rapid evolution of AI will shift the landscape from a fragmented ecosystem to one where content creation becomes so automated that social media may lose its authenticity, forcing a move toward new forms of media.
